tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List supported Amazon storefronts (id, domain, defaultLocale, currency, catalogCount, trackingTag). amazon.com (US) and amazon.se (Sweden, default) have hand-picked catalogs. Pass marketplace (e.g. amazon.com) + locale (e.g. en-US) on shopping tools.

tools.name: create_and_fill
tools.description: One call: create a new puppy / kitten gift wishlist pre-filled with hand-picked products and return id, editToken, ownerUrl (edit) and shopUrl (share with gift-givers). US shoppers: marketplace=amazon.com, locale=en-US, itemQueries in English (e.g. dog bed). Sweden: marketplace=amazon.se, locale=sv-

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search pet welcome-kit / first-30-days supplies on an Amazon storefront. Returns search links (results) plus matching hand-picked products with /dp/ links (catalogMatches). marketplace=amazon.com + locale=en-US → English amazon.com results tagged sw-petbox-20; amazon.se → tag sw-petbox-21. marketpla

tools.name: create_wishlist
tools.description: Create an empty pet welcome-kit list. Returns id, editToken, ownerUrl, shopUrl. Pass marketplace (amazon.com for US, amazon.se for Sweden) + locale.

tools.name: add_item
tools.description: Add an item to an existing pet kit list (requires editToken). Pass the list's marketplace (amazon.com or amazon.se) + locale.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.description: Resolve ASIN, Amazon URL, or keywords to a buyUrl on the chosen storefront. amazon.com links carry sw-petbox-20, amazon.se links sw-petbox-21 (trackingTag). marketplace optional (fallback: country → en-US → amazon.com → else amazon.se).

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_marketplaces" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
